day_pass_detail: The six- and twelve-month terms are cheaper per month — $128 for 4x, $228 for 8x, $278 unlimited on six months, $250 unlimited on twelve — but they are terms, not month-to-month, so they do not set the headline
sourcing_notes: The rate card states a single price per tier and names no enrollment or annual fee anywhere on the page. Both are recorded as sourced zeros rather than as unknowns, on the CorePower precedent.

The $125 five-class pack and the $55 two-class offer are both listed under the studio’s "Specials" as summer or new-client rates, so both are flagged promotional and neither derives the per-class figure. A promo pack setting the standing per-class rate becomes a wrong number the day the offer ends.
The one-month unlimited at $350 takes the headline because it is the only option a walk-in can buy without a six- or twelve-month term. The cheaper monthly figures on this page all carry one.
